title: Mini observability tour: compact cards, latency heatmap and traceview story pack
text:
Mini observability tour: compact cards, latency heatmap and traceview story pack

description:
Scope: Create a compact, reusable set of onboarding visuals and exported screenshots that demonstrate Redwood Console observability flows: 1) compact card grid for top-level insights (avg latency, cost per token, error rate), 2) an interactive-looking latency heatmap frame (hourly distribution), and 3) a focused trace waterfall/detail view for a single slow request with annotations. Deliverables: Figma frames (desktop/tablet/mobile), high-fidelity PNG exports at three widths (1440px, 1024px, 375px), a ‘callouts’ overlay variant for documentation, and an annotated copy doc for Engineering/Docs. Non-goals: full redesign of dashboard components or instrumentation changes. Notes: Align copy with quickstart wording in docs (callouts should match phrasing in PRD). Create lightweight A/B variants for the hero card (tokens-first vs latency-first) for later experimentation.

acceptance_criteria:
Figma file contains a single page 'Mini Tour' with three sections: Cards, Heatmap, Traceview
Exports: PNGs at 1440px/1024px/375px for each main frame and callout overlay variants
Annotation layer with numbered callouts and copy for each asset, exported as a separate PDF
Accessibility check: color contrast ratios documented and meeting WCAG AA for callout text
Design handoff artifact (screenshot spec + CSS token notes) added to Drive and linked in ticket

design_notes:
Prefer compact card layout to reduce cognitive load on first-run users; emphasize avg latency and cost-per-token as primary metrics
Heatmap uses 6 buckets (very low -> very high) and includes median latency tooltip state in microcopy
Traceview frame highlights KV-cache hit/miss and model variant fallback sections (collapsed by default in main UI, expanded in doc screenshot)
Mobile variants should prioritize single-column stacking and condensed callouts with truncated examples
Provide two hero card variants for A/B: 'Cost-first' shows cost-per-token large, 'Latency-first' shows 99th percentile latency large

notes_for_engineering:
Provide a stable screenshot route for traceview that can be used in docs (include query params to lock time window)
Exported PNGs should be 2x @ target widths for retina clarity; include transparent background option for compositing
Expose CSS tokens used for card colors and spacing so docs can reference exact values

comments:
2026-03-03 - Asha: Initial outline posted. Decided to keep heatmap static in screenshots but include tooltip callout as separate overlay.
2026-03-05 - Rohit: ENG asked to include KV cache indicator in traceview; added as explicit callout. ENG-7732 will deliver the indicator in the next sprint.
2026-03-08 - Maya: Suggested stronger visual emphasis for cost-per-token since that is a common customer ask; created 'cost-first' variant.
2026-03-10 - Diego: Started exporting desktop assets; will upload mobile after UX sign-off. Blocking: need final copy from Docs (PM-4022).
2026-03-12 - Asha: Uploaded annotated PDF and handoff spec. Ready for design review and accessibility check.
